answer: A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jade counter is kept in walnut and hollow exposes each reset. An attacker hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1862 identities would post 4480 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
